what: While several screen-height photos pass by in turn, the words of the big center sentence attach one per photo. Word i rises with photo i and is pinned in the same spot the moment that photo’s top edge touches the top of the screen, while earlier words stay so the sentence completes (the pin is released when the group’s bottom edge touches the bottom of the screen, no spacing offset). Photos move with a half-speed parallax inside their cell, y −50%→50%

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo frames (children, multiple) — frame height is how long one word stays. The first child inside moves with parallax
options.[data-fx-part=lead]: Sentence (one child) — per word <span>. The part makes as many layers as there are photos so each layer shows only its own word (if words outnumber photos, the leftover words go on the last layer)
options.parallax: If off, photo parallax is disabled, on by default
options.touch: Touch device pin position — default ”50% 50%” (pins when the word center reaches the screen center, original touch behavior)

use: Here Word We build up
note: Text color is --kf-contrast-ink since it sits on a photo. The layers are aria-hidden and the original sentence (lead) is moved off-screen so reading tools read it only once

from.where: about.html .mr-aimgs — original about__images__lead (three layered words, pin top top → about__images bottom bottom, pinSpacing false) · about__images__photo img y -50%→50% scrub · on touch start 50% 50%
